sections.title: RAPID OPS COMPANY
sections.body:
*Semper Primus*

This handbook covers what's expected in ROC. If something isn't in here, ask Command.

ROC runs on trust. There's no application to join and no long list of regulations to memorize. Just a few rules that keep this fair and enjoyable for everyone.

You're expected to hold up your end. Respect the people you're playing with and the mission, and don't make Command chase you over basic decency.

fields.name: 01  ·  Respect everyone
fields.value:
No harassment, no personal attacks, no targeting people outside the server. Banter's fine. Don't make it personal.
`Warning, then removal if it continues.`

fields.name: 02  ·  Zero tolerance on slurs
fields.value:
No exceptions for jokes, context, or bypassing filters with spaces or symbols.
`Immediate removal. No warning.`

fields.name: 03  ·  13+ only
fields.value: This is Discord's own rule. We enforce it too.

fields.name: 04  ·  No malicious links or doxxing
fields.value:
Sharing someone's personal info without consent, or posting harmful links.
`Immediate ban. Non-negotiable.`

fields.name: 05  ·  Respect the mission
fields.value: Don't sabotage ops, teamkill for fun, or grief teammates in-game. Bad calls happen. Malicious ones get you removed.

fields.name: 06  ·  Mic on, mic respectful
fields.value:
No music blasting, no screaming over comms, no talking over whoever's running the op.
`Warning, then mute if it continues.`

fields.name: 07  ·  Keep drama in DMs
fields.value: Beef between two people stays between two people. Don't drag it into general or into an op.

fields.name: 08  ·  No DM advertising
fields.value: No unsolicited server ads, here or in DMs to our members.

fields.name: 09  ·  Command has final say
fields.value: If Command or 2iC makes a call mid-op, it stands. Disagree after, in DMs, not during.

fields.name: 10  ·  Wear the uniform
fields.value:
All personnel run a **black outfit** in game. It's how ROC reads as one unit on the field and in the footage, and it's the only kit rule there is.
`Turn up out of uniform and you'll be asked to change before the op starts.`

fields.name: 11  ·  No application, no free pass
fields.value: You joined easy. That's the deal. Repeated no-shows, disruption, or breaking rule 01 or 02 gets you removed.

sections.title: ENFORCEMENT
sections.body:
Command and 2iC handle enforcement directly, case by case. At our size there's no formal appeals board and no infraction point system.

**Small stuff gets a warning first. Serious stuff doesn't.**

If you think a call was wrong, bring it up in DMs, not in the moment.
